name: markdown-preview
description: Live Markdown view of the Claude Code conversation in a browser previewer (styled after nvim-md-preview)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color palette of the preview page. github is the original look and follows the system's light/dark mode; the page's light/dark button switches any theme to its counterpart.

inlineCodeColor.title: Inline code
inlineCodeColor.description: Text color of `inline code`, e.g. #cba6f7. Empty uses the theme.

strongColor.title: Bold
strongColor.description: Text color of **bold** text, e.g. #7a9cff. Empty uses the theme.

customCss.title: Custom CSS
customCss.description: Path of a CSS file loaded after the built-in styles. Empty uses ~/.claude/markdown-preview/custom.css when it exists.
